source: Owner's EL7 Fatso bounces over 2_FATSO_EL7x_-_Input_2.wav (Warmth off): Warmth 2 / 5 / 6 / 7. Music, 96 kHz float stereo, 8.35 s, voice level -23.05 dBFS (regionAlignDb). Audio not in the repo.
harness: scripts/phatass-fatso-fit.mjs (rebuild of the dev log's scratch harness; per 1024-sample frame and band 100-500 / 0.5-1 / 1-2 / 2-4 / 4-8 / 8-16 kHz, out/in dB, ours minus Fatso, mean solved as Output, rms). Tape shelf alone: WARM, 2 kHz, 35 ms.
alignment: 85 ms blocks, integer lag in +-24, neighbours within +-2 samples (the Fatso's own gain-dependent phase); blocks kept 95/98, 98/98, 96/98, 95/98.

gainLawFit.note: best threshold re voice (dB) / Range, 2 dB grid refined to 0.5 dB; Range from 3/6/9/12/18

verdict: Limiter law kept. Knees gain <= 0.013 where the Fatso barely acts and lose at Warmth 7 (the FATSO detent's point); tanh is worst everywhere. Steeper-than-limiter laws were already worse (dev log).
